lineage.description: Building footprints were extracted from OpenStreetMap as volunteered geographic information, with AI-assisted mapping used to estimate total building coverage. The dataset represents approximately 67% of total buildings in New Zealand based on AI-mapped estimates, with an average data age of 4 years and recent updates within the last 6 months.
